I love those choices! 'The Sellout' is particularly insightful about social issues, and 'Oscar Wao' definitely captures that sense of identity struggle. We should also think about how these texts could provide a contrast to Shakespeare’s works. Do you want to set up a time to meet and dive deeper into these ideas?

Absolutely! How about we meet later this week to brainstorm further? I can bring my notes on the themes, and we can see how to weave everything together.
